limitations: All scores are provisional browser assessments based on the supplied screenshots and runtime account; no independent interaction was performed.
Corresponding transition images were considered with settled screens; stills show visual consistency but cannot establish motion comfort or interaction timing.
Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, native hit testing, keyboard, speech, haptics, payments and OS sharing remain unverified and do not receive certification.
Supplied runtime checks support browser feedback and accessibility scores, but axe and geometry results do not prove complete keyboard or assistive-technology usability.
Sheets 23–27 contain contrast-labeled captures with absent interface text; these conflict with the stated exclusion of atmosphere-only diagnostics and cannot establish readable settled UI.

The blank contrast captures were excluded from production-state grading pending capture-purpose clarification; if they depict actual reachable UI, essential missing text triggers the at-most-5 overall gate.
Viewport-edge cropping and scrolled screenshots do not prove unreachable content; reported overflow checks support reflow, while visible header-edge fragments remain polish concerns.
Synthetic long answers, sources, option wording and layout messages were treated as fixtures, not production-copy defects or model-quality evidence.
Circles is assessed only as an offline surface; successful authentication, creation, invitation and sharing states are not demonstrated.
Browser voice evidence covers mocked recognition lifecycle, and purchase evidence covers simulation rather than real speech or transactions.
No novice-use study or predictive-accuracy evidence was supplied.

For each item, A is the mean of its non-null aesthetic dimensions, F is the mean of its non-null functional dimensions, and overall is round(0.4A + 0.6F, 1); null denotes a genuinely inapplicable dimension.
The authorized A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met across all screens and components; deferred native evidence alone was not used to impose a blanket browser score ceiling.
topFixes: Clarify why a failed omen still consumes the daily attempt and use plain language for storage failures.
Improve enlarged and constrained layouts around fixed headers, crowded custom-answer navigation and distant primary actions.
Keep provider and purpose context visible beside the final AI consent choices.
Standardize uncertainty wording and replace All evidence with a label appropriate to speculative explanations.
Make city search and offline recovery the strongest available actions in their respective states.
Clarify the blank contrast captures before treating the visual evidence set as complete.
